transportMechanisms.phenomenon: Forward Osmosis Water Flux with Internal Concentration Polarization (ICP)
transportMechanisms.equation: J_w = A * [ (pi_draw * exp(-J_w * S / D) - pi_feed * exp(J_w * (t_f / D_f))) - Delta_P ]
transportMechanisms.description: Governs continuous water permeation driven exclusively by the osmotic pressure gradient across the selective active layer, attenuated by solute accumulation and dilutive internal concentration polarization in the porous support layer.
Quantifies the mass of draw solute diffusing backward into the whey feed stream per liter of extracted water. Low values (<0.15 g/L) ensure dairy purity without salt contamination.

transportMechanisms.phenomenon: Loose Nanofiltration Mineral Partitioning & Ash Rejection
transportMechanisms.description: Describes how loose NF polypiperazine membranes allow monovalent ions (Na+, K+, Cl-) and lactic acid to pass freely into permeate (R_ash < 15%) while rejecting >99% of proteins and >92% of lactose.

transportMechanisms.equation: tau_wall = 8 * mu * v_feed / d_h  [tau < 0.25 Pa in hollow-fiber lumens]
transportMechanisms.description: Hollow-fiber lumen fluid velocities maintain low laminar shear stress, preventing mechanical aggregation, hydrophobic cleft unfolding, and thermal denaturation of delicate immunoglobulins and lactoferrin.
